subject.title: fix(gateway): fail fast on missing local probe auth

question: Should unresolved configured local gateway credentials terminate status before any WebSocket probe, replacing the shipped warning-plus-probe behavior?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but it intentionally removes a compatibility fallback and changes auth and status semantics for existing installations; source inspection cannot determine the desired product contract.

options.title: Preserve probe compatibility
options.body: Continue the real probe by default and surface the credential diagnosis prominently alongside its result.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed status
options.body: Approve the stricter default with fresh-install and upgrade proof for token, password, SecretRef, and paired-device configurations.

recommendation.title: Preserve probe compatibility
recommendation.body: Continue the real probe by default and surface the credential diagnosis prominently alongside its result.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared gateway-auth refactor is the strongest history signal for ownership of this cross-command fallback and upgrade-policy decision.
